notes.title: Content Update
notes.content:
Hello drum friends,
9 new run levels are online and can be found in the skill tree.
We have also updated a few little things within the levels.

notes.title: Feature Update
notes.content:
Hello drum friends, 
today we are introducing a new game mode. In section 1 you now have 5 run levels with our drum tablature, which shows you visually what you are playing. 
There is also a new ‘Platforms’ page in the menu. This shows you which platforms belong to which drum or cymbal. You can also find the combined platforms such as bassdrum + hihat there.
Have fun!

notes.title: Content Update
notes.content:
Hello drum friends,
here is another update for you. 5 new levels with more cool pop & rock grooves and a few varied fills.
We have also implemented a small but nice feature that automatically adjusts the game to your playing speed. Have fun!

notes.title: Content Update
notes.content:
Hello drum friends,
we have the next level update for you! Five new levels in which you'll learn the most famous drum groove of all time. We call it the Bum-Zack Groove - have fun. ;)

notes.title: Content Update
notes.content:
Hello drum friends,
today we have a small content update for you - the first of many to come in the next few weeks ;)

Included are three new levels in which you will learn a very familiar disco beat, new animations and two mini bug fixes.
